newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA and Air India to resume talks.
newsitem.headline: SIA and Air India to resume talks.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) and Air India will resume talks on a variety of issues including code sharing and marketing arrangements, an SIA spokesman said on Monday.
He told Reuters the talks would resume "sometime in June".
Last month, officials from the two airlines met on May 20 to discuss code-sharing and other arrangements but the talks ended without any results, he said.
In a report carried in the daily Straits Times newspaper, SIA director for corporate affairs Mathew Samuel was quoted as saying the May 20 talks were "wide-ranging" and "fruitful".

"SIA discussed the most wide-ranging proposals for cooperation which goes beyond just code-sharing. We talked of joint ventures in groud services, catering and so on in India. These proposals were in response to Air India's request for broad-based cooperation," said Samuel.
He added that Air India asked for time to consider these proposals.
